meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Policy rates and auction results are final when announced. The Handbook restates a few effective dates between editions (newest edition wins, differences listed in rates-policy meta). Lending and deposit rates: each monthly release repeats the full history; the newest release wins.
meta.coverage: What each state pays to borrow: the cut-off yield and the amount raised at auction, for 31 states and union territories, each financial year since 2005-06
meta.note: RBI, Details of State Governments Market Borrowings (DBIE report 1213; also 1219), ACTUALS rows. The state is read from each loan's name ('7.44% TAMILNADU SGS 2033'); the RBI spells states many ways (110 spellings for about 31 states), normalised by a fixed alias table in the adapter. Amount raised = bids accepted plus any devolvement. Yields are weighted by amount raised. The current financial year is not over. From April 2019 the state-year totals are checked against the RBI's auction press releases (Data Bank rbi_sdl_auctions): 232 of 232 agree within 1%.
